title: Sr. Business Analyst II ( Policy Decision )
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people by providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.
  
  
We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise.
  
  
While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity
  
  
What’s In It For U
  
  

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work-life balance while staying connected and collaborative.
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need, when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and support you throughout your entire first year.
* Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within, with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.
* Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally.
* Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.
* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.

Insurity’s Next Sr. Business Analyst II
  
  
You will play a key role in ensuring the successful delivery and quality of Insurity’s insurance software solution. As a Sr. Business Analyst II, your primary focus will be to support the team by bridging business needs with technology, gathering and analyzing requirements, and facilitating communication to ensure alignment and clarity.
  
  
This role involves developing deep expertise in the insurance domain and insurance data warehouses, while collaborating during testing phases to validate business solutions. You will strengthen the team’s capabilities by translating complex insurance requirements into actionable insights and supporting the delivery of high-value, high-quality software.
  
  
This role requires a strong commitment to the continuous development of both technical knowledge and business acumen, with a focus on commercial insurance processing and reporting requirements, including operational, financial, and regulatory needs. The role also requires a commitment to assessing and supporting ongoing process improvement.

* Communicate project risks, concerns, and quality metrics to leadership and team members.
* Manage multiple priorities with strong time management and organizational skills.
* Participate in straightforward system design and configuration activities.

Who We’re Looking For
  
  

* Recommended: 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in Commercial Insurance.
* Recommended: Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Strong understanding of the insurance domain and commercial lines of business such as Auto, Property, and Liability.
* Experience engaging with technical and business stakeholders in Agile and/or Waterfall environments.
* Proficiency with requirement gathering and documentation tools.
* Ability to effectively translate complex insurance requirements to technical teams and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Self-starter who thrives in a collaborative and evolving environment.
* Experience supporting testing activities and validating business scenarios.
* Familiarity with cloud-native SaaS software development is preferred.
* Insurance-related certifications such as AINS or CPCU are a plus.

Closing Note
  
  
Thank you for your interest in Insurity. Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

title: Market Research Analyst
description:
**About the Role:**
Attentive AI is a construction technology company building the future of takeoff and estimating software. As we continue to scale our go-to-market motion, our Data Operations function plays a central role in sustaining a high-velocity outbound sales engine. We are seeking a detail-oriented, entry-level Data Analyst to join this team and support a growing roster of 15+ Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) with clean, enriched, and actionable B2B prospect data across the US and Canadian construction market. This role offers direct, measurable impact on pipeline quality and revenue generation from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Prospecting & Data Management
  
  

* Source and maintain a high-quality B2B prospecting database targeting general contractors, subcontractors, specialty trades, and material suppliers.
* Use ZoomInfo and Seamless.AI to research, enrich, and verify contact-level and company-level data.
* Perform regular data hygiene tasks including deduplication, validation, and formatting of prospect records.
* Organize and maintain structured spreadsheets and tracking files to support SDR outreach workflows.

Market Research & GTM Support
  
  

* Conduct market research to identify new target segments, whitespace opportunities, and construction trade verticals.
* Assist in mapping Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) criteria to sourced prospect lists.
* Support go-to-market strategy execution by preparing segmented and prioritized lead lists aligned to campaign goals.
* Monitor competitor activity and construction market trends to surface relevant intelligence for the sales team.

Reporting & Analysis
  
  

* Build and maintain Excel/Google Sheets-based dashboards and reports tracking pipeline coverage, data quality metrics, and SDR outreach performance.
* Identify patterns and trends in lost-deal data, outreach response rates, and ICP match rates.
* Present weekly data readouts to the Senior Data Analyst and sales leadership.

**Requirements**
Must-Have Skills
  
  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets including formulas, pivot tables, filters, and data formatting.
* Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of ZoomInfo and/or Seamless.AI for prospecting and contact enrichment.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct structured market research and synthesize findings.
* Understanding of B2B sales motions, GTM strategy, and outbound pipeline fundamentals.
* Familiarity with automation tools and the practical application of AI in everyday tasks using AI to work faster and more accurately, with sound judgment on when and how to apply it.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, or RocketReach.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for data entry and management.
* Basic Python or SQL knowledge for data manipulation and automation (not required but a strong plus).
* Knowledge of the US/Canada construction industry NAICS codes, trade segments, procurement cycles.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 0–1 year of relevant experience in data operations, sales operations, market research, or business analytics.

title: SAP-BODS-Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS, working with SAP functional and technical consultants to analyze data migration requirements and design appropriate solutions. You will also provide advisory services to understand and address data management issues.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
* Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration challenges and optimize processes
* Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
* Managing data migration projects, including building, testing, and executing migrations with tools like SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
* Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing strategies
* Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
* Developing data models and performing complex data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
* Creating technical specification documents to guide the development of data services jobs
* Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools such as Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
* Advising clients on data management strategies and techniques to enhance data quality and optimize data management processes

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications in SAP Data and Analytics solutions, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Warehouse (BW/4HANA), SAP Data Intelligence, or related data platform credentials
* Demonstrating proficiency in Snaplogic for data migration
* Utilizing SAP BODS and LTMC for data migration projects
* Designing data migration solutions with SAP Data Services
* Managing data cleansing activities using Information Steward
* Analyzing complex data migration requirements and legacy data
* Excelling in data integration and data quality improvement plans

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

**BGV:**

title: Business Analyst – Data & Integration
description:
We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong experience in data-intensive business initiatives, data integration, data warehouse solutions, and enterprise technology transformation. The ideal candidate should have the ability to understand complex business processes, analyze data flows, document functional requirements, and translate business needs into clear specifications for technical teams.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, developers, QA teams, and operational teams to define requirements, assess business impacts, document existing and future-state processes, and ensure that data solutions meet business expectations. The role requires strong analytical skills, an understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, and experience with data mapping, data validation, reconciliation, and user acceptance testing.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across business and technical teams, managing requirements through the delivery lifecycle, and supporting enterprise data initiatives across different business domains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage business stakeholders, subject matter experts, data owners, and technology teams to gather, analyze, and validate business requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to understand business processes, reporting requirements, data dependencies, and operational needs.
* Document business requirements, functional specifications, business rules, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Analyze existing business processes, data flows, applications, and integration patterns to understand current-state functionality.
* Document source systems, target systems, data inputs, outputs, transformation rules, processing frequency, and downstream consumers.
* Perform impact analysis to assess the business and operational implications of system changes, data transformations, and process enhancements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify dependencies involving databases, ETL workflows, external vendor feeds, internal extracts, datasets, and reporting processes.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, data dictionaries, business glossaries, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Translate business rules and reporting requirements into clear functional requirements for developers and solution architects.
* Work with data engineers and developers to validate that implemented solutions align with approved business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, consolidate redundant data processing, improve data quality, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Define data validation rules, expected outcomes, business control totals, reconciliation requirements, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Support test planning, test scenario development, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Coordinate business validation of data outputs and assist in investigating discrepancies with technical teams.
* Document defects, assess business impact, prioritize issues, and track resolution through the appropriate delivery processes.
* Maintain requirements traceability from initial business needs through solution design, development, testing, and implementation.
* Coordinate stakeholder reviews, requirement sign-offs, business approvals, and operational readiness activities.
* Maintain business process documentation, decision logs, issue registers, risk records, and meeting outcomes.
* Support change management, knowledge transfer, and transition of new or enhanced processes to business and operational teams.
* Communicate project status, business impacts, dependencies, and outstanding decisions clearly to stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in business analysis, preferably in data integration, data warehousing, data migration, reporting, or enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder interviews, workshop facilitation, and business process analysis.
* Proven ability to document business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of relational databases, data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data integration concepts.
* Experience preparing source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, data flow documentation, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Ability to analyze data dependencies, downstream impacts, processing requirements, and business-critical data flows.
* Experience supporting data quality validation, reconciliation, testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data discrepancies and clarify complex business rules.
* Experience coordinating with developers, solution architects, QA teams, business users, and operational stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and requirements or work-tracking tools.
* Strong documentation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and workstreams while maintaining accuracy and traceability.

title: Senior Manager – Total Rewards (Reward Reporting & Analytics)
description:
**About EXL**

EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and AI company helping leading organizations across insurance, healthcare, banking, retail, communications, media, and energy transform operations, improve outcomes, and accelerate growth. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in New York, EXL employs approximately 68,000 professionals worldwide and is part of the S&P MidCap 400.

**Role Overview**

The
**Senior Manager – Total Rewards (Reward Reporting & Analytics)**
is a key member of EXL's Corporate Rewards team and reports to the
**Senior Assistant Vice President, Reward Analytics & Reporting**
. This global specialist role supports compensation, benefits, incentive programs, reporting, and reward governance across multiple geographies.

The role converts complex reward and workforce data into actionable insights that support compensation decisions, budgeting, workforce planning, compliance, and executive reporting. It is a hands-on individual contributor position requiring strong analytical capability, business judgment, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Reward Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop and enhance monthly and quarterly reward dashboards.
* Provide insights on pay positioning, compensation costs, incentive funding, and workforce trends.
* Deliver executive-ready analytics and recommendations.
* Automate recurring reporting processes and improve data quality.
* Conduct cost modeling, scenario analysis, and workforce simulations.

**2. Compensation & Incentive Programs**

* Support annual compensation review cycles, including budget modeling and pay distribution analysis.
* Administer short-term incentive programs, bonus plans, and sales commission structures.
* Analyze compensation requests related to promotions, retention, mobility, and market adjustments.
* Ensure reward decisions align with global compensation frameworks and local regulations.

**3. Job Pricing & Market Benchmarking**

* Participate in compensation and benefits surveys (Mercer, WTW, Aon, Korn Ferry, Radford, etc.).
* Conduct market pricing and salary positioning analyses.
* Support job evaluation, leveling, and survey benchmarking activities.
* Maintain consistency between internal job structures and market data.

**4. Pay Equity & Transparency**

* Perform pay equity, gender pay gap, and diversity-related reward analyses.
* Support regulatory and voluntary pay transparency reporting.
* Conduct statistical analyses and remediation modeling.
* Maintain auditable documentation and reproducible methodologies.

**5. Workforce Cost & Budget Management**

* Support HR budgeting, forecasting, and compensation cost tracking.
* Analyze headcount trends, compensation movements, and budget variances.
* Partner with Finance and Controllership during planning cycles.
* Identify risks and provide recommendations regarding workforce costs.

**6. Benefits & Reward Projects**

* Support reward initiatives involving benefits, incentives, recognition, and EVP programs.
* Conduct cost-benefit analyses and utilization reviews.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for reward design decisions.

**7. Reward Data & Systems**

* Ensure integrity and governance of compensation and benefits data.
* Build reusable data models and reporting frameworks.
* Partner with HRIS and Shared Services teams on reward system administration.
* Maintain compliance with data privacy and confidentiality standards.

**8. Stakeholder Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders.

title: Senior Analyst - Marketing Analytics
description:
**About the role**

The Senior Analyst, Marketing Analytics is a data specialist on Global Digital Marketing Analytics team, responsible for building and maintaining trustworthy, well-structured datasets and dashboards behind the team's marketing reporting. The focus is reliable data — correctly sourced, assembled, and validated — and reports the team can trust.

This is a role for someone who works with data fluently and independently: able to take a reporting goal, determine what data it requires, and shape it into a sound dataset and a clear dashboard. It suits someone who takes ownership of quality — checking for completeness, confirming data is merged correctly, validating against source systems, and catching problems before they reach a report.

It is also a role for someone who wants to work smarter, more efficiently. We expect this person to bring AI into how they workday to day — using it to speed up data preparation, validation, and dashboard development — and to continuously look for opportunities to automate repetitive work, so the team’s reporting runs faster and more reliably.

**What you’ll do**

**Data Sourcing & Preparation**

* Determine the data required for reporting purposes, identifying the right sources and the appropriate fields to meet them.
* Build and prototype datasets structured for clean, efficient consumption in the reporting platform.
* Combine data across multiple sources, ensuring it is merged and transformed correctly for the intended use.

**Quality & Validation**

* Validate data for completeness and accuracy throughout the workflow and against source systems.
* Own data quality as a standard, building checks into the process and serving as the quality backstop the team relies on.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies, recognizing when results do not hold up and tracing them to their source.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build, prototype, and maintain dashboards and BI products in the team’s reporting platform.
* Keep BI products accurate, current, and reliable over time, refining outputs as needs evolve.
* Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, dashboards, and data processes, keeping it clear and current.
* Handle ad-hoc data pulls and requests, turning them around with accuracy and appropriate context.
* Coordinate with the broader BI and insights teams so datasets and dashboards support how reporting and interpretation are used.

**AI & Automation**

* Bring AI into day-to-day data preparation, validation, and dashboard work to improve speed and reliability.
* Identify and automate repetitive data and reporting tasks, reducing manual effort and the risk of error.
* Experiment with new AI tools and approaches, adopting them where they raise the quality or efficiency of the team’s work.

**What you’ll need**

* 3–5 years of experience working hands-on with data analysis and reporting; experience in marketing analytics or digital analytics.
* Strong data preparation and transformation skills, with the ability to source, combine, and shape data from multiple systems into clean, reliable datasets. Proficiency in SQL for querying, combining, and transforming data; Python a plus.
* Strong, hands-on skills building dashboards and BI products in Power BI; Data Studio (Looker) experience a plus.
* Comfort using and experimenting with AI tools, and an interest in applying them to automate and improve data and reporting work.
* Experience with the digital marketing stack(e.g., Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Customer Data Platform).
* Strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership over the accuracy of what the team produces.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, business, or related field.

title: Snowflake Engineer
description:
**ole Overview**

The Data Warehouse Engineer serves as the primary technical lead for the Snowflake data warehousing ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing scalable data models, managing Snowflake environments, optimizing performance and cost, enforcing security policies, and supporting analytics and enterprise reporting platforms, including Business Objects (BIC), across the organization. The DW Engineer ensures that Snowflake is stable, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards, and collaborates with Platform Administrators and third‑party vendors to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of issues impacting reporting availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Modeling & Architecture**

* Design enterprise‑level Snowflake models including conformed dimensions, fact tables, and semantic views.
* Document ERDs, modeling assumptions, and physical/logical architectures.
* Establish and enforce modeling standards, naming conventions, and performance optimization patterns.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Build advanced SQL transformations across all Snowflake layers.
* Implement automated workflows using Tasks, Streams, procedures, and time‑based orchestration.
* Support schema evolution and large‑scale data integration patterns.

**Environment & Release Management**

* Coordinate Snowflake schema and object deployments via Git or CI/CD pipelines.
* Own release readiness for Snowflake across Dev, Test, and Prod.
* Ensure new models, views, RBAC changes, and stored procedures are validated prior to promotion.

**Performance Optimization**

* Conduct performance tuning through micro‑partition analysis, clustering, query plan reviews, and caching strategies.
* Implement Resource Monitors, usage alerts, and proactive performance dashboards.
* Review warehouse utilization to ensure compute resources are right‑sized and cost‑optimized.

**Security, RBAC & Controls**

* Design and maintain Snowflake role hierarchies, object privileges, row‑level security, and masking policies.
* Support audit requests, compliance checks, and evidence gathering for reviews.
* Govern secure internal and external data sharing.

**Cost Management**

* Produce recurring consumption reports to support conduct cost optimization analysis.
* Recommend improvements in warehouse sizing, retention policies, storage optimization, and compute scheduling.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Data Engineers to coordinate ingestion design, transformation logic, and schema updates.
* Partner with BI teams to optimize datasets for Power BI, Qlik, and analytical tools.
* Align with Platform Administrators on environment setup, migrations, and operational readiness.

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain transformation specifications, lineage, and architectural diagrams.
* Ensure models and pipelines comply with governance policies and development standards.

**Enterprise Operational Reporting Platform (Web Intelligence)**

* Collaborate with Platform Administrators and the vendor to ensure reporting platform uptime and timely escalation of reporting issues.

**Skills & Tools Requirements**

* **Snowflake SQL**
  : 5+ years of advanced SQL development experience, including complex query optimization, data modeling, performance tuning, and ETL/ELT development within Snowflake environments.
* **Snowflake Administration**
  : 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake platforms, including security, role-based access control (RBAC), warehouse management, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost governance.
* **dbt (Data Build Tool)**
  : 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data transformation frameworks using dbt, including testing, documentation, and CI/CD integration.
* **Git / Version Control**
  : 5+ years of experience using Git-based source control systems (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) for collaborative development, branching strategies, code reviews, and release management.
* **CI/CD Pipelines & Deployment Automation**
  : 5+ years of experience implementing and supporting CI/CD pipelines for data warehouse and analytics deployments, including automated testing, code promotion, release management, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent platforms
* **Financial services experience**
  : Preferred.
* **Business Objects (SAP BO/Web Intelligence)**
  : Preferred.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Senior
description:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior – Audit Analytics, you will support the delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Principal Data Advisor
description:
Financial Data Advisor
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
**If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!**
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
  
  
SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. The SimCorp DMS Advisory and change management service is a team of industry and data management experts who consistently monitor for any industry, regulatory and vendor feed changes that may affect our client’s business operations. The Advisory Service regularly informs clients of these changes, and how best to adapt.
  
  
As a Senior Data Advisor, you will be responsible to look after the client onboarding, monitoring vendor changes, maintaining the standard data model and orchestrating change management activities for the SimCorp DMS clients by liaising with internal service teams from IT and Operations. You will be directly reporting to the head of Data Advisory team
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Create and maintain data standards (lookups, mappings, conventions, and rules), data models and data ontologies (how are data objects related to each other)
* Maintain meta data information documentation regarding data models, data interpretation, data lineage and utilization along the key processes and make it available to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor, track and conduct assessment of all vendors related changes that impacts SimCorp DMS and Enterprise Data Manager clients.
* Facilitate Change & Control Board (CCB) governance with internal service teams to prioritize and deliver the standard and client change requests.
* Design and implement a robust client onboarding framework for a seamless DMS client onboarding
* Serve as the advisor and quality gateway regarding data and change integrations related to data.
* Support design and maintenance of an overall data test concepts and conduct regular data tests to assure data and service quality.
* Support DMS Operations on various process improvement initiatives.
* Advise clients on data needs and data usage for new requirements.
* Build and maintain in-depth know-how on industry and regulatory changes within data management.
* This is a client-centric role that involves regular interaction with our valued customers
* Continuously develop a comprehensive understanding of the latest industry and regulatory trends in the data management space and promote best practices within the SimCorp community to benefit our clients.

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.
  
  

* Have a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent in finance
* Relevant experience in areas of Change Management with data vendor feeds (Bloomberg, IDC, Reuters, etc.)
* Have good knowledge of financial products and markets including derivatives, structured instruments etc.
* Have experience in requirements engineering, data modelling and full SDLC approach.
* Have a structured approach, attention to detail, service mindset, and solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Process management, control and design experience are beneficial skills but not mandatory.
* Have relevant experience in Data Management and Business Analysis
* Possess strong knowledge of various investment/trade lifecycle activities
* Show the ability to collaborate easily with various departments to ensure client success.
* Exhibit clear verbal and written communication to engage and inform various stakeholders

**Benefits**
Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please click below to apply or get in touch with
**Swati Pal**
, Talent Partner on
**Swati.pal@simcorp.com**
to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp offers regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: E-commerce operations
description:
**We are looking for an experienced and proactive E-commerce Operations Manager to oversee and scale the day-to-day operations of our baby care and hygiene product portfolio across major online channels (Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, and D2C Shopify).

In this role, you will hold end-to-end ownership of catalog management, inventory health, order fulfillment coordination, platform promotions, and operational customer support to ensure seamless growth and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1. Listing & Catalog Optimization

Create, manage, and optimize product listings across all platforms, including accurate product titles, bullet points, backend keywords, descriptions, and A+ / Enhanced Brand Content.

Maintain catalog hygiene: monitor buy boxes, resolve suppressed listings, fix barcode/SKU sync errors, and manage category approvals.

Ensure pricing parity, discount coupons, and bundling strategies align across channels.

2. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination

Monitor daily sales velocity, inventory turn rates, and stock levels across warehouse hubs (FBA, seller hubs, local dispatch).

Forecast reorder points to prevent stockouts while avoiding excessive holding or platform storage fees.

Coordinate with production and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to ensure timely dispatch, inbounding, and delivery tracking.

3. Marketplace Growth & Campaign Execution

Plan and implement platform participation in major shopping festivals, flash sales, lightning deals, and seasonal campaigns.

Monitor on-platform ad performance (Sponsored Products/Brands) alongside organic ranking, coordinating budget adjustments to maximize Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Track competitor pricing, new product rollouts, and category trends in baby care/FMCG.

4. Performance Tracking & Customer Experience

Monitor account health metrics, seller ratings, order defect rates (ODR), and customer feedback across portals.

Review customer queries, returns, and reviews to identify recurring quality or packaging issues, coordinating improvements with packaging/fulfillment teams.

Prepare weekly and monthly reports on sales revenue, platform fees, return percentages, and net contribution margins.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of proven experience managing seller panels for e-commerce brands (Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart, Shopify, or Quick Commerce like Blinkit/Zepto).

Domain Knowledge: Direct experience in FMCG, personal care, baby products, or consumable goods is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formulas for stock and order tracking).

Platform Mastery: Thorough understanding of marketplace compliance, FBA/marketplace inbounding processes, catalog guidelines, and review policies.

Soft Skills: High ownership, meticulous attention to detail, strong vendor coordination skills, and a data-driven approach to troubleshooting.**

title: Revenue Assurance Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Revenue Assurance Manager is responsible for ensuring complete, accurate, and timely revenue recognition from Enterprise customers across all CPaaS products and services. The role acts as a bridge between Sales, Operations, Product, Billing, and Finance to prevent revenue leakage, validate commercial terms, reconcile usage with billing, improve billing accuracy, and strengthen revenue controls.

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical capabilities, experience in telecom/CPaaS billing systems, and a sound understanding of enterprise contracts, invoicing, collections, and financial controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Revenue Assurance & Billing**

* Ensure 100% revenue capture for all Enterprise CPaaS services.
* Monitor revenue leakage across SMS, Voice, WhatsApp Business, RCS, Email, OTP, and other communication channels.
* Validate customer usage records against invoices generated.
* Identify and resolve billing discrepancies before invoice generation.
* Ensure billing is completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Monitor unbilled and deferred revenue and ensure timely invoicing.

**Contract & Commercial Validation**

* Review customer contracts, purchase orders, and commercial approvals.
* Validate tariffs, discounts, credit limits, and billing frequencies.
* Ensure pricing in billing systems matches approved commercial agreements.
* Verify implementation of contract amendments and change requests.

**Revenue Reconciliation**

* Reconcile:
* Carrier/vendor usage vs customer billing
* Platform usage vs invoices
* CRM/Sales Orders vs Billing System
* Revenue recognized vs collections
* Investigate revenue variances and recommend corrective actions.

**Enterprise Sales Support**

* Partner with Enterprise Sales teams during customer onboarding.
* Ensure all commercial documents are complete before activation.
* Support sales with revenue analysis and customer billing clarifications.
* Validate special pricing approvals and promotional offers.

**Financial Controls**

* Develop and maintain revenue assurance controls.
* Perform periodic audits of billing and revenue processes.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards (Ind AS 115 / IFRS 15 where applicable).
* Support statutory, internal, and customer audits.

**Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly Revenue Assurance MIS.
* Publish dashboards covering:
* Revenue leakage
* Billing accuracy
* Unbilled revenue
* Credit note analysis
* Revenue realization
* Collection trends
* Present findings and recommendations to management.

**Automation & Process Improvement**

* Drive automation in reconciliation and billing validation.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to improve billing systems.
* Implement controls to eliminate manual intervention.
* Identify process improvements to reduce billing disputes.

**Collections Coordination**

* Coordinate with Accounts Receivable for disputed invoices.
* Assist in resolving billing-related customer escalations.
* Reduce revenue realization delays caused by billing issues.

**Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, Telecom Billing, Finance Operations, or Enterprise Finance.
* Minimum 3 years in the CPaaS, Telecom, SaaS, or Enterprise Technology industry.
* Experience with high-volume enterprise billing environments is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of CPaaS products:
* A2P SMS
* OTP
* Voice
* WhatsApp Business API
* RCS Messaging
* Email APIs
* Push Notifications
* Knowledge of telecom billing and mediation systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel.
* SQL for data analysis (preferred).
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.).
* CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, or equivalent).
* Power BI/Tableau for dashboarding.

**Core Competencies**

* Revenue Assurance
* Financial Controls
* Billing Management
* Revenue Recognition
* Commercial Acumen
* Analytical Thinking
* Process Automation
* Stakeholder Management
* Risk Assessment
* Data Analysis
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* CPaaS
* Telecom
* Cloud Communications
* SaaS
* Messaging Aggregators
* Enterprise Communications
* Digital Platforms

**Success Criteria (First 12 Months)**

* Achieve billing accuracy above
  **99.9%**
  .
* Reduce revenue leakage to
  **below 0.10%**
  of billed revenue.
* Eliminate manual billing exceptions through automation wherever feasible.
* Implement end-to-end reconciliation between CRM, CPaaS platform, billing system, and ERP.
* Publish standardized Revenue Assurance dashboards for management.
* Strengthen internal controls to ensure compliance with commercial approvals and revenue recognition policies.

title: eCommerce Growth Manager
description:
**Company:**
Transverse Solutions

**Location:**
Noida

**Work Mode:**
Full-time | On-site / Hybrid

**Experience:**
2-4 years

**Compensation:**
₹25,000–₹35,000 per month + performance incentives

**About Transverse Solutions**

Transverse Solutions is an eCommerce consultancy helping brands build, launch and grow their businesses online.

We work with D2C brands across Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart and other digital commerce platforms - bringing together eCommerce strategy, technology, performance marketing and conversion optimisation.

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing & Marketplace Manager who can take ownership of the digital growth of our clients and, most importantly, help turn marketing activity into measurable sales.

**The Role**

This is not a social media management role.

And it is not a role where success is measured by how many campaigns were launched or how many reports were prepared. You will be responsible for growing sales for assigned eCommerce brands across: Shopify + Meta Ads + Google Ads + Amazon + Flipkart + Other Marketplaces.

You will independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise campaigns and marketplace operations for your assigned clients.

You will typically own 4 major client accounts at a time, with the possibility of supporting a few additional accounts on smaller requirements.

Your core question every day should be:
*“What can we do today to sell more profitably than yesterday?”*

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Performance Marketing - Meta Ads

* Independently plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns for D2C brands.
* Develop acquisition, retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Manage campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers and campaign approaches.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns.
* Monitor key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and revenue.
* Manage and optimise campaigns based on agreed client objectives.

2. Google Ads

* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns.
* Work across Search, Shopping and Performance Max as relevant.
* Manage keyword strategy, search terms, budgets and bidding.
* Monitor product/feed-related issues in coordination with the relevant team.
* Optimise campaigns based on conversion and revenue data.
* Identify opportunities for profitable scaling.
* Track and analyse Google Ads performance alongside Shopify sales data.

3. Shopify eCommerce Growth

While you will not be responsible for Shopify development, you will be responsible for understanding the sales funnel and identifying where marketing performance is being affected. You should be comfortable analysing: Ad → Landing Page → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase

You will:

* Monitor Shopify sales and conversion metrics.
* Identify funnel drop-offs.
* Analyse product-level performance.
* Identify products that should be promoted or deprioritised.
* Recommend improvements to offers, promotions and campaigns.
* Work closely with our eCommerce/Shopify team when website or CRO issues are identified.
* Connect advertising performance with actual business revenue.

4. Amazon & Flipkart Management

Take end-to-end ownership of assigned marketplace accounts. Responsibilities include:

Marketplace account management.

Product catalogue management.

Listing optimisation.

Keyword optimisation.

Search visibility improvement.

Sponsored Ads / marketplace advertising.

Product-level sales analysis.

Campaign optimisation.

Promotions and deal planning.

Pricing and offer recommendations.

Identifying high-potential SKUs.

Identifying underperforming products.

Monitoring account health and operational issues.

Monitoring inventory-related issues and coordinating with clients.

Regularly analysing marketplace reports and identifying growth opportunities.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

You should be comfortable working with numbers.

You will be expected to:

\* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly performance.

\* Analyse advertising and sales data.

\* Track ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and revenue.

\* Identify trends and anomalies.

\* Prepare concise performance reports.

\* Translate data into actionable recommendations.

\* Explain why performance changed, not simply report what changed.

We don’t want dashboards full of numbers.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and say:

*“Here’s the problem. Here’s why it’s happening. Here’s what I’m going to do about it.”*

**Working With Our Internal Team**

You will work closely with:

Head – Digital Marketing

For digital strategy, SEO, marketplace expertise and overall marketing direction.

eCommerce / Shopify Team

For website, CRO, tracking and technical requirements.

Creative & Content Team

For ad creatives, content and campaign briefs.

Founder / Leadership

For client strategy, commercial priorities and growth planning.

You will be responsible for translating strategy into execution and measurable performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

*Must Have*

\* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing/eCommerce.

\* Proven experience managing client brands, preferably D2C/eCommerce.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads.

\* Experience managing Amazon and/or Flipkart accounts.

\* Good understanding of Shopify and the D2C sales funnel.

\* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and other performance metrics.

\* Ability to independently launch and optimise campaigns.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable taking ownership of client performance.

\* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage deadlines.

*Strong Advantage*

\* Experience scaling D2C brands.

\* Experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets.

\* Experience with Amazon Sponsored Ads.

\* Experience with Flipkart Ads.

\* Experience with Google Shopping / Performance Max.

\* Experience with GA4, Google Merchant Center and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

\* Experience with quick-commerce platforms.

\* Experience working with fashion, beauty, food, toys, lifestyle or other consumer brands.

**The Person We’re Looking For**

*You could be a great fit if you:*

\* Think about sales, not just campaigns.

\* Enjoy looking at data and figuring out what’s wrong.

\* Don’t need to be told what to optimise.

\* Can independently manage an account from strategy to execution.

\* Are comfortable experimenting and testing.

\* Know that a campaign being “live” doesn’t mean it is successful.

\* Can explain performance in simple business terms.

\* Take ownership when numbers aren’t working.

\* Are curious about why customers buy - and why they don’t.

*You may NOT be the right fit if:*

\* Your primary experience is social media posting/community management.

\* You have only executed campaigns based on someone else’s instructions.

\* You primarily create reports without taking action on them.

\* You have never independently managed ad accounts.

\* You consider “campaign launched” to be the end of the job.

\* You are uncomfortable being accountable for measurable performance.

**How We Measure Success**

Your performance will ultimately be evaluated on the growth and efficiency of the accounts you manage. Key metrics may include:

* Revenue Growth
* ROAS / CAC
* Conversion Rate
* Paid Traffic Quality
* Marketplace Sales Growth
* Marketplace Advertising Efficiency
* Account Health

Execution Quality & Timeliness

The exact targets will vary by client depending on their category, product, pricing, margins, inventory, website and stage of growth.

**Compensation**

₹25,000-₹35,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Additional performance incentives may be offered based on account-level performance and achievement of agreed targets.

**Why Join Transverse Solutions?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work on real eCommerce businesses, not just isolated advertising campaigns.

You’ll work across:

Shopify → Meta → Google → Amazon → Flipkart → Quick Commerce

and understand how all these channels come together to build an actual eCommerce business.

If you’re someone who gets excited when a client’s numbers move from:

₹5L → ₹8L → ₹12L

rather than simply getting excited about a campaign going live… we’d like to meet you.

**Apply**

Please share your CV along with a brief note highlighting:

1. The eCommerce/D2C brands you’ve worked with.

2. The platforms you’ve managed.

3. Approximate monthly ad budgets you’ve independently handled.

4. One brand/account where you were directly involved in improving sales.

5. Your current/expected compensation.

Only candidates with genuine hands-on performance marketing experience will be considered.

title: Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expert || 15 year || Noida || Only Immediate Joiner
description:
**Job Descriptions**

**Role:**
Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expert

**Work Location:**
Noida / Gurgaon

**Experience Required:**
15+ Year

**Role:**
Business Analyst – Accounts Payable (AP Domain Expert)

**Primary Skills:**
Salesforce, Business Analysis (BA)

**Secondary Skills:**
Accounts Payable (AP) Domain Expertise, Touchless Invoice Processing, Agentic AI in Accounts Payable

**Location:**
Noida / Gurgaon

**Experience:**
15+ Years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong expertise in the Accounts Payable (AP) domain, Salesforce, and business process transformation. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of end-to-end invoice processing workflows, touchless invoice processing rules, and the application of Agentic AI in Accounts Payable.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and technology teams to analyze business requirements, define process improvements, and drive automation initiatives across the AP lifecycle. Experience in Salesforce-based solutions, intelligent automation, and AI-driven finance operations will be highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Analysis & Salesforce

* Engage with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements, functional requirements, and business process specifications.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, gap analysis, and impact assessments.
* Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and process workflows.
* Leverage Salesforce capabilities to support business process management, workflow automation, case management, and integration with enterprise finance systems.
* Collaborate with Salesforce developers, solution architects, QA teams, and product owners to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Manage requirements traceability, backlog prioritization, UAT planning, defect resolution, and business sign-off.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives, technical solutions, and operational requirements.

2. Accounts Payable Domain Expertise

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of the end-to-end Accounts Payable lifecycle, including:
* Invoice receipt and capture.
* Invoice data extraction and validation.
* Purchase order (PO) and non-PO invoice processing.
* Two-way and three-way matching.
* Duplicate invoice detection.
* Exception handling and discrepancy resolution.
* Approval workflows and payment readiness.
* ERP integration, vendor master validation, and payment processing.
* Understand AP controls, compliance requirements, audit trails, segregation of duties, and exception management.
* Identify process bottlenecks and recommend improvements to reduce invoice processing time, cost, and manual intervention.
* Define business rules, validation logic, exception categories, and escalation mechanisms for invoice processing.

3. Touchless Invoice Processing

* Define and document touchless invoice processing rules to maximize straight-through processing (STP).
* Identify the business conditions required for invoices to be processed without manual intervention.
* Establish rules for PO matching, tolerance thresholds, tax validation, vendor validation, duplicate checks, coding, and approval routing.
* Define exception scenarios and business rules for routing invoices to the appropriate teams.
* Analyze touchless processing performance using KPIs such as:
* Touchless processing rate.
* First-pass match rate.
* Invoice exception rate.
* Invoice cycle time.
* Cost per invoice.
* Manual intervention rate.
* Work with automation, data, and technology teams to continuously improve AP process efficiency and accuracy.

4. Agentic AI in Accounts Payable

* Identify and evaluate use cases for applying Agentic AI across the Accounts Payable lifecycle.
* Define business requirements for AI agents supporting invoice intake, data validation, PO matching, exception investigation, and workflow orchestration.
* Identify opportunities for AI-driven decision support, autonomous task execution, and intelligent exception resolution.
* Define agent workflows, business rules, decision boundaries, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms.
* Establish controls to ensure traceability, explainability, accuracy, compliance, and appropriate authorization for AI-driven actions.
* Collaborate with AI/ML, automation, and engineering teams to translate AP business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions.
* Define success metrics to measure the impact of Agentic AI on touchless processing, productivity, accuracy, and operational cost.

5. Stakeholder Management & Delivery

* Act as the primary liaison between finance stakeholders, operations, business leadership, and technology teams.
* Facilitate solution design discussions and validate proposed solutions against business needs.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, solution demonstrations, UAT, and implementation activities.
* Prepare process maps, business requirement documents (BRDs), functional requirement documents (FRDs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support change management and business adoption.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 15+ years of overall professional experience, with significant experience in business analysis, finance transformation, or enterprise process automation.
* Strong hands-on experience in business analysis, requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and functional documentation.
* Experience with Salesforce capabilities, including workflow automation, case management, business process configuration, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong domain knowledge of Accounts Payable, invoice processing, PO matching, exception handling, and vendor management.
* Practical understanding of touchless invoice processing, straight-through processing, and rules-based automation.
* Understanding of Agentic AI concepts and their application to finance and AP operations.
* Experience working with ERP and finance platforms such as SAP, Oracle, or other enterprise financial systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams in a complex enterprise environment.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in finance transformation, intelligent automation, RPA, OCR/IDP, and AI-enabled business processes.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Flow, Service Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, or other relevant Salesforce capabilities, depending on the solution architecture.
* Exposure to AI agents, LLM-based workflows, orchestration frameworks, and human-in-the-loop operating models.
* Experience defining AP process KPIs, automation business cases, and continuous improvement roadmaps.
* Experience in consulting, BPM, or large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Key Success Criteria

The successful candidate will help deliver measurable improvements in AP operations through effective business analysis, Salesforce-enabled workflows, higher touchless invoice processing rates, reduced exception volumes, and responsible adoption of Agentic AI.

**Work Location:**
Noida / Gurgaon

**Experience Required:**
15+ Year
